plan.title: test(windows): 4 unit tests and 2 unhandled errors fail on Windows in ts:check-lane

narratives.Description: test(windows): 4 unit tests and 2 unhandled errors fail on Windows in ts:check-lane
narratives.Overview: Windows ts:check-lane red from POSIX host assumptions and bare node_modules/.bin/tsx spawn; Prefer-A Bound hardens the four failing unit tests without raising timeout first.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer, I want Windows ts:check-lane suite green, so that Prefer-A Bound product work can ship without activation/write-fence blocks.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Split disable-flag into always-on source assert + win32-gated sh spawn; skipIf win32 on chmod +x; normalize npm-pack CRLF/tar listing; spawn wave2q via process.execPath + resolved tsx JS entry with child error listener; keep 30s timeout.
narratives.AcceptanceJustification: Thin activation only: product ACs remain soft-missing until product ships; 6 Bound limbs are confessed/unverifiable at activation. Prefer-A Bound stamp keeps >5 criteria with this justification so swarm:launch can admit the ready brief.

items.title: Split disable-flag into always-on helper-source assert and win32-gated sh behavioral spawn

narrative.Acceptance: Bound 6431020190 P1: portable source assert always runs; sh/chmod behavioral half gated on win32

items.title: Gate chmod execute-bit assertion with it.skipIf win32

narrative.Acceptance: Bound 6431020190 P2: chmod +x assertion skipped on win32 only

items.title: Normalize npm-pack stdout CRLF and tar listing to forward-slash exact bin.js entry

narrative.Acceptance: Bound 6431020190 P3: CRLF normalize; split /\r?\n/; listing.status===0 fail-closed; exact package/dist/bin.js

items.title: Spawn wave2q self-complete via process.execPath plus resolved tsx JavaScript CLI entry

narrative.Acceptance: Bound 6431020190 P4: all platforms; fail clearly if unresolved; no .cmd-without-shell or shell:true

items.title: Attach child error listener so launch failures reject as ordinary test failures

narrative.Acceptance: Bound 6431020190 P4: no unhandled spawn errors

items.title: Keep concurrent self-complete timeout at 30s until measured residual after green spawn

narrative.Acceptance: Bound 6431020190: do not raise timeout before ENOENT fix
